findings.title: New optional dependency mypy (>=1.15; extra == "dev"), not declared by 0.17.0
findings.explanation: 0.17.0 declared 0 runtime dependencies; 0.17.1 adds mypy (>=1.15; extra == "dev"). The newest stable version is mypy@2.3.1, published on 2026-08-15T03:01:23Z (28d8h58m36s ago); the package's first release dates from 2009-09-09T17:34:48Z (6211d18h25m11s ago); deps.dev knows mypy@2.3.1. PyPI has no download counts. It is declared under the extra "dev", which pip installs only when that extra is requested, so the level stays at the configured one
